title: Be Human...Or Die Trying
description:
Use the bathroom or defend your home from zombies? The choice is yours! Be Human... Or Die trying is a 1-8 player co-op defense game where killing zombies is just as important as taking a shower. Also did I mention that you play an alien in a mech suit? Yeah it's a weird game like that.

SHOOT ZOMBIES

Join up to 8 other players as you shoot zombies and defend your home while trying to complete strange objectives!

ARRANGE FURNITURE

A well furnished and well arranged home is the difference between victory and defeat!

DO HUMAN THINGS

Humans like to do so many things, whether it's paying bills or scoring touchdowns we got you covered!

SHOP FOR GUNS AND FURNITURE

Take the time to shop for the things you really need before the zombies break all of your windows!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR LOOK

How good you look affects how well you play...right?

DON'T GET OVERRUN

Your goal is to be human or die trying!

FEATURES

• 8 Player online multiplayer

• 11 levels with different objectives

• Character customization

• Offline single player

• Slight commentary on late stage capitalism
